flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/NoticeSearch/{form/NoticeSearchAllForm,hook/useSearch,hook/useSearchParams} (search by warrant_no), pages/Notice/form/NoticeOccurences (shows warrant_no, empty Record Update form), utils/models/Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts; ocmsadminapi api-authorization.properties (/v1/warrantofarrest). No warrant of arrest controller/entity in the six repos
note: The story asks the officer to search for a notice and update the warrant number and type of warrant. What exists is a notice search by Warrant No. in Notice Search (GET warrantofarrest resource) and a read-only warrant_no display in the Notice Occurrences tab. There is no form to enter/update a warrant: the Record Update tab holds inputs with empty source, no warrant fields and no submit. On the server there is no warrant of arrest controller, entity or repository in the six repos (only the /v1/warrantofarrest authorization entry), so whether a generic CRUD exists elsewhere cannot be verified from the repo. The story status is blank in the data; the requirement is not given. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Claim only a small part (UI notice search by warrant_no). The warrant update form and its storage do not exist; the warrantofarrest server side cannot be verified from the repo

steps.step: Officer searches for a notice by warrant number
steps.detail: The staff portal has a Warrant No. field in Notice Search (max 22 characters); useSearchParams calls getNoticesByWA, which GETs the warrantofarrest resource filtered by warrant_no[$regex], and uses the result as the notice list. The OCMS_NOTICE_SEARCH authorization lists /v1/warrantofarrest. However there is no warrant of arrest controller/entity/repository in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, thirdpartyapi or ocmseserviceapi (grep for warrant/WarrantOfArrest in Java src returns nothing), so the server side cannot be verified from the repo. This is a notice search by warrant number, not a dedicated screen for updating warrants. The same generic search is used in OCMS27.21-27.25.

steps.step: Officer enters warrant number and warrant type
steps.detail: There is no form for entering a warrant. Only the Iwarrantofarrest type (Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts:17-18, 22-36), i18n validation messages (translation.json:1331-1334, 1354-1356) that no component uses (grep for warrant_status_flag/warrant_type in tsx returns nothing), and the Record Update tab in NoticeOccurences.tsx:257-283 whose inputs have empty source and no warrant fields or submit button.

steps.step: OCMS saves the updated warrant details on the notice
steps.detail: There is no POST/PUT/PATCH endpoint for warrant of arrest and no entity/repository for it in the six repos (grep returns nothing); the only link to warrantofarrest is the GET from the search.

steps.step: Updated warrant details show correctly on the notice
steps.detail: The Notice Occurrences tab shows warrant_no columns and fields read-only from the offencenoticeoccurrences resource (NoticeOccurences.tsx:89-92, 203-206), mounted in Form.tsx:224. That resource also has no controller/entity in the six repos, so real data cannot be verified from the repo; the warrant type field and the update result are not shown.
